> AGENT

Ctrl+A already exists for select-all at `rust/crates/app/src/router.rs:1224`.

The issue is Cmd (Super) key. Crossterm on macOS **cannot reliably detect the Super/Cmd modifier** — most terminals don't pass `Cmd+key` combos through to the application. They're intercepted by the terminal emulator itself (e.g., `Cmd+A` in iTerm/Terminal.app selects all terminal output).

**Options:**

1. **Keep Ctrl+A** (already works) — standard for TUI apps on macOS
2. **Map Cmd+A via terminal emulator config** — e.g., in iTerm2, remap `Cmd+A` to send `\x01` (Ctrl+A) so it reaches your app. Not something your app can control.
3. **Use a different binding** — but Ctrl+A is already the universal TUI convention

**Verdict:** Not possible to intercept Cmd+A at the application level in a terminal. Ctrl+A is the correct approach and it's already implemented. If you want Cmd+A specifically, configure your terminal emulator to remap it.

> AGENT

No. Terminal emulators don't support changing the mouse cursor shape from the application side. There's no escape sequence for it — the cursor is always the terminal's default pointer.

What you **can** do (and already do based on CLAUDE.md): change the **border color** on hover/drag as visual feedback. That's the standard TUI approach.

11	pub fn role_style(role: &MessageRole) -> Style {
12	    match role {
13	        MessageRole::User => Style::default().fg(Color::Green),
14	        MessageRole::Assistant => Style::default().fg(Color::White),
15	        MessageRole::System => Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray),
16	    }
17	}
18	
19	pub fn render_chat(f: &mut Frame, tab: &TabState, area: Rect, _focused: bool) {
20	    let inner = area;
21	
22	    if tab.messages.is_empty() && tab.streaming.is_none() {
23	        let placeholder = Paragraph::new("Start a conversation...")
24	            .style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray));
25	        f.render_widget(placeholder, inner);
26	        return;
27	    }
28	
29	    let mut lines: Vec<Line> = Vec::new();
30	
31	    for msg in &tab.messages {
32	        let prefix = match msg.role {
33	            MessageRole::User => "You: ",
34	            MessageRole::Assistant => "Claude: ",
35	            MessageRole::System => "System: ",
36	        };
37	        let style = role_style(&msg.role);
38	        lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(
39	            prefix,
40	            style.add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
41	        )));
42	        for content_line in msg.content.lines() {
43	            lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(
44	                format!("  {}", content_line),
45	                Style::default().fg(Color::White),
46	            )));
47	        }
48	        lines.push(Line::default());
49	    }
50	
51	    if let Some(chunk) = &tab.streaming {
52	        lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(
53	            "Claude: ",
54	            Style::default()
55	                .fg(Color::White)
56	                .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
57	        )));
58	        for content_line in chunk.lines() {
59	            lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(
60	                format!("  {}", content_line),
61	                Style::default().fg(Color::White),
62	            )));
63	        }
64	        lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled(
65	            "  \u{258a}",
66	            Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan),
67	        )));
68	    }
69	
70	    let total_lines = lines.len();
71	    let visible_height = inner.height as usize;
72	    let scroll = if total_lines > visible_height {
73	        (total_lines - visible_height) as u16
74	    } else {
75	        0
76	    };
77	
78	    let para = Paragraph::new(lines).scroll((scroll, 0));
79	    f.render_widget(para, inner);
80	}

  "new_string": "/// Simple word-wrap: split line into chunks of at most `width` display columns.\nfn wrap_line(text: &str, width: usize) -> Vec<String> {\n    if width == 0 || text.is_empty() {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n    let chars: Vec<char> = text.chars().collect();\n    if chars.len() <= width {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n    let mut result = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n    while start < chars.len() {\n        let end = (start + width).min(chars.len());\n        if end >= chars.len() {\n            result.push(chars[start..].iter().collect());\n            break;\n        }\n        // Try to break at a space\n        let mut break_at = end;\n        for i in (start..end).rev() {\n            if chars[i] == ' ' {\n                break_at = i;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        if break_at == start {\n            break_at = end;\n        }\n        result.push(chars[start..break_at].iter().collect());\n        start = break_at;\n        // Skip leading spaces on next line\n        while start < chars.len() && chars[start] == ' ' {\n            start += 1;\n        }\n    }\n    result\n}"

116	/// Simple word-wrap: split line into chunks of at most `width` display columns.
117	fn wrap_line(text: &str, width: usize) -> Vec<String> {
118	    if width == 0 || text.is_empty() {
119	        return vec![text.to_string()];
120	    }
121	    let chars: Vec<char> = text.chars().collect();
122	    if chars.len() <= width {
123	        return vec![text.to_string()];
124	    }
125	    let mut result = Vec::new();
126	    let mut start = 0;
127	    while start < chars.len() {
128	        let end = (start + width).min(chars.len());
129	        if end >= chars.len() {
130	            result.push(chars[start..].iter().collect());
131	            break;
132	        }
133	        // Try to break at a space
134	        let mut break_at = end;
135	        for i in (start..end).rev() {
136	            if chars[i] == ' ' {
137	                break_at = i;
138	                break;
139	            }
140	        }
141	        if break_at == start {
142	            break_at = end;
143	        }
144	        result.push(chars[start..break_at].iter().collect());
145	        start = break_at;
146	        // Skip leading spaces on next line
147	        while start < chars.len() && chars[start] == ' ' {
148	            start += 1;
149	        }
150	    }
151	    result
152	}

  "new_string": "fn push_spans_content_row<'a>(\n    spans: Vec<Span<'a>>,\n    border_style: Style,\n    bubble_width: usize,\n    content_width: usize,\n    rows: &mut Vec<(Line<'a>, Alignment)>,\n    align: Alignment,\n) {\n    // Truncate spans to fit content_width\n    let mut truncated: Vec<Span<'a>> = Vec::new();\n    let mut remaining = content_width;\n    for span in spans {\n        let char_count = span.content.chars().count();\n        if remaining == 0 {\n            break;\n        }\n        if char_count <= remaining {\n            remaining -= char_count;\n            truncated.push(span);\n        } else {\n            let text: String = span.content.chars().take(remaining).collect();\n            truncated.push(Span::styled(text, span.style));\n            remaining = 0;\n        }\n    }\n    let used: usize = truncated.iter().map(|s| s.content.chars().count()).sum();\n    let pad_right = bubble_width.saturating_sub(2 + BUBBLE_PAD + used + BUBBLE_PAD);\n    let mut all_spans = vec![\n        Span::styled(\"│\", border_style),\n        Span::raw(\" \".repeat(BUBBLE_PAD)),\n    ];\n    all_spans.extend(truncated);\n    all_spans.push(Span::raw(\" \".repeat(pad_right + BUBBLE_PAD)));\n    all_spans.push(Span::styled(\"│\", border_style));\n    rows.push((Line::from(all_spans), align));\n}"
}

Alignment,\n    border_color: Color,\n    text_color: Color,\n    bubble_width: usize,\n    content_width: usize,\n    rows: &mut Vec<(Line<'a>, Alignment, Vec<(usize, usize, LinkTarget)>)>,\n    cwd: &std::path::Path,\n) {\n    let border_style = Style::default().fg(border_color);\n    let role_style = Style::default().fg(border_color).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);\n\n    // Top border\n    let tag = format!(\" {} \", label);\n    let remaining = bubble_width.saturating_sub(3 + tag.len());\n    rows.push((Line::from(vec![\n        Span::styled(\"╭─\", border_style),\n        Span::styled(tag, role_style),\n        Span::styled(\"─\".repeat(remaining) + \"╮\", border_style),\n    ]), align, Vec::new()));\n\n    // Content — parse for code blocks\n    let segments = rows, align);\n                    } else {\n                        push_linked_content_row(&line_text, text_color, border_style, bubble_width, content_width, &links, rows, align);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            ContentSegment::Code { lang, code } => {\n                // Code header\n                let header = format!(\"── {} \", if lang.is_empty() { \"code\" } else { lang });\n                let header_pad = content_width.saturating_sub(header.chars().count());\n                push_styled_content_row(\n                    vec![\n                        Span::styled(header, Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)),\n                        Span::styled(\"─\".repeat(header_pad), Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)),\n                    ],\n                    border_style, bubble_width, rows, align,\n                );\n\n                let highlighted = highlight_code(code, lang, content_width);\n                for hl_line in highlighted {\n                    push_spans_content_row(hl_line, border_style, bubble_width, content_width, rows, align);\n                }\n\n                let footer_pad = content_width;\n                push_styled_content_row(\n                    vec![Span::styled(\"─\".repeat(footer_pad), Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray))],\n                    border_style, bubble_width, rows, align,\n                );\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Bottom border\n    let bottom_fill = bubble_width.saturating_sub(2);\n    rows.push((Line::from(vec![\n        Span::styled(\"╰\", border_style),\n        Span::styled(\"─\".repeat(bottom_fill), border_style),\n        Span::styled(\"╯\", border_style),\n    ]), align, Vec::new()));\n}\n\nfn push_content_row<'a>(\n    text: &str,\n    text_color: Color,\n    border_style: Style,\n    bubble_width: usize,\n    content_width: usize,\n    rows: &mut Vec<(Line<'a>, Alignment, Vec<(usize, usize, LinkTarget)>)>,\n    align: Alignment,\n) {\n    let display: String = text.chars().take(content_width).collect();\n    let char_count = display.chars().count();\n    let pad_right = bubble_width.saturating_sub(2 + BUBBLE_PAD + char_count + BUBBLE_PAD);\n    rows.push((Line::from(vec![\n        Span::styled(\"│\", border_style),\n        Span::raw(\" \".repeat(BUBBLE_PAD)),\n        Span::styled(display, Style::default().fg(text_color)),\n        Span::raw(\" \".repeat(pad_right + BUBBLE_PAD)),\n        Span::styled(\"│\", border_style),\n    ]), align, Vec::new()));\n}\n\nfn push_linked_content_row<'a>(\n    text: &str,\n    text_color: Color,\n    border_style: Style,\n    bubble_width: usize,\n    content_width: usize,\n    links: &[InlineLink],\n    rows: &mut Vec<(Line<'a>, Alignment, Vec<(usize, usize, LinkTarget)>)>,\n    align: Alignment,\n) {\n    let display: String = text.chars().take(content_width).collect();\n    let base_style = Style::default().fg(text_color);\n    let (content_spans, link_infos) = spans_with_links(&display, base_style, links);\n\n    let char_count: usize = content_spans.iter().map(|s| s.content.chars().count()).sum();\n    let pad_right = bubble_width.saturating_sub(2 + BUBBLE_PAD + char_count + BUBBLE_PAD);\n\n    let mut all_spans = vec![\n        Span::styled(\"│\", border_style),\n        Span::raw(\" \".repeat(BUBBLE_PAD)),\n    ];\n    all_spans.extend(content_spans);\n    all_spans.push(Span::raw(\" \".repeat(pad_right + BUBBLE_PAD)));\n    all_spans.push(Span::styled(\"│\", border_style));\n\n    rows.push((Line::from(all_spans), align, link_infos));\n}\n\nfn push_styled_content_row<'a>(\n    spans: Vec<Span<'a>>,\n    border_style: s.content.chars().count()).sum();\n    let pad_right = bubble_width.saturating_sub(2 + BUBBLE_PAD + text_len + BUBBLE_PAD);\n    let mut all_spans = vec![\n        Span::styled(\"│\", border_style),\n        Span::raw(\" \".repeat(BUBBLE_PAD)),\n    ];\n    all_spans.extend(spans);\n    all_spans.push(Span::raw(\" \".repeat(pad_right + BUBBLE_PAD)));\n    all_spans.push(Span::styled(\"│\", border_style));\n    rows.push((Line::from(all_spans), align, Vec::new()));\n}\n\nfn push_spans_content_row<'a>(\n    spans: Vec<Span<'a>>,\n    border_style: Style,\n    bubble_width: usize,\n    content_width: usize,\n    rows: &mut Vec<(Line<'a>, Alignment, Vec<(usize, usize, LinkTarget)>)>,\n    align: Alignment,\n) {\n    let mut truncated: Vec<Span<'a>> = Vec::new();\n    let mut remaining = content_width;\n    for span in spans {\n        let char_count = span.content.chars().count();\n        if remaining == 0 {\n            break;\n        }\n        if char_count <= remaining {\n            remaining -= char_count;\n            truncated.push(span);\n        } else {\n            let text: String = span.content.chars().take(remaining).collect();\n            truncated.push(Span::styled(text, span.style));\n            remaining = 0;\n        }\n    }\n    let used: usize = truncated.iter().map(|s| s.content.chars().count()).sum();\n    let pad_right = bubble_width.saturating_sub(2 + BUBBLE_PAD + used + BUBBLE_PAD);\n    let mut all_spans = vec![\n        Span::styled(\"│\", border_style),\n        Span::raw(\" \".repeat(BUBBLE_PAD)),\n    ];\n    all_spans.extend(truncated);\n    all_spans.push(Span::raw(\" \".repeat(pad_right + BUBBLE_PAD)));\n    all_spans.push(Span::styled(\"│\", border_style));\n    rows.push((Line::from(all_spans), align, let theme = ts.themes.get(\"base16-ocean.dark\")\n        .or_else(|| ts.themes.get(\"Solarized (dark)\"))\n        .or_else(|| ts.themes.values().next())\n        .unwrap();\n\n    let syntax = if !lang.is_empty() {\n        ss.find_syntax_by_token(lang)\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| ss.find_syntax_plain_text())\n    } else {\n        ss.find_syntax_plain_text()\n    };\n\n    let mut hl = HighlightLines::new(syntax, theme);\n    let mut result = Vec::new();\n\n    for line in LinesWithEndings::from(code) {\n        let ranges = match hl.highlight_line(line, ss) {\n            Ok(r) => r,\n            Err(_) => {\n                result.push(vec![Span::styled(\n                    line.trim_end_matches('\\n').to_string(),\n                    Style::default().fg(Color::White),\n                )]);\n                continue;\n            }\n        };\n        let spans: Vec<Span> = ranges.iter().map(|(style, text)| {\n            Span::styled(\n                text.trim_end_matches('\\n').to_string(),\n                to_ratatui_style(*style),\n            )\n        }).collect();\n        result.push(spans);\n    }\n    result\n}\n\n// ── Content parsing ──\n\nenum ContentSegment {\n    Text(String),\n    Code { lang: String, code: String },\n}\n\nfn parse_content(content: &str) -> Vec<ContentSegment> {\n    let mut segments = Vec::new();\n    let mut current_text = String::new();\n    let mut in_code = false;\n    let mut code_lang = String::new();\n    let mut code_buf = String::new();\n\n    for line in content.lines() {\n        if !in_code && line.starts_with(\"```\") {\n            if !current_text.is_empty() {\n                segments.push(ContentSegment::Text(current_text.clone()));\n                current_text.clear();\n            }\n            code_lang = line.trim_start_matches('`').trim().to_string();\n            code_buf.clear();\n            in_code = true;\n        } else if in_code && line.starts_with(\"```\") {\n            segments.push(ContentSegment::Code {\n                lang: code_lang.clone(),\n                code: code_buf.clone(),\n            });\n            code_lang.clear();\n            code_buf.clear();\n            in_code = false;\n        } else if in_code {\n            if !code_buf.is_empty() {\n                code_buf.push('\\n');\n            }\n            code_buf.push_str(line);\n        } else {\n            if !current_text.is_empty() {\n                current_text.push('\\n');\n            }\n            current_text.push_str(line);\n        }\n segments.push(ContentSegment::Text(current_text));\n    }\n\n    segments\n}\n\n// ── Word wrapping ──\n\nfn wrap_text(text: &str, width: usize) -> Vec<String> {\n    let mut result = Vec::new();\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        result.push(String::new());\n        return result;\n    }\n    for line in text.lines() {\n        if line.is_empty() {\n            result.push(String::new());\n width: usize) -> Vec<String> {\n    if width == 0 || text.is_empty() {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n    let chars: Vec<char> = text.chars().collect();\n    if chars.len() <= width {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n    let mut result = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n    while start < chars.len() {\n        let end = (start + width).min(chars.len());\n 209	        let border_style = Style::default().fg(COLOR_ASSISTANT);

&state.chat_selection {\n        Some(s) => s,\n        None => return,\n    };\n\n    // Normalize: start <= end\n    let (sr, sc, er, ec) = if sel.start_row < sel.end_row\n        || (sel.start_row == sel.end_row && sel.start_col <= sel.end_col)\n    {\n        (sel.start_row, sel.start_col, sel.end_row, sel.end_col)\n    } else {\n        (sel.end_row, sel.end_col, sel.start_row, sel.start_col)\n    };\n\n    let mut lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n\n    for &(row, ref text) in &state.chat_row_text {\n        if row < sr || row > er {\n            continue;\n        }\n        let chars: Vec<char> = text.chars().collect();\n        // We need to figure out where this row starts on screen.\n        // chat_row_text stores (screen_row, plain_text).\n        // The selection cols are screen-absolute, but text is the full line content.\n        // For simplicity, use the chat_area_rect.x as the base.\n        let base_x = state.chat_area_rect.x;\n        let start_char = if row == sr {\n            (sc.saturating_sub(base_x)) as usize\n        } else {\n            0\n        };\n        let end_char = if row == er {\n            (ec.saturating_sub(base_x)) as usize\n        } else {\n            chars.len()\n        };\n        let start_char = start_char.min(chars.len());\n        let end_char = end_char.min(chars.len());\n        if end_char > start_char {\n            let selected: String = chars[start_char..end_char].iter().collect();\n            lines.push(selected);\n        } else {\n            lines.push(String::new());\n        }\n    }\n\n    let text = lines.join(\"\\n\");\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Copy to clipboard via pbcopy (macOS)\n    if let Ok(mut child) = std::process::Command::new(\"pbcopy\")\n        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())\n        .spawn()\n    {\n        if let Some(stdin) = child.stdin.as_mut() {\n            let _ = stdin.write_all(text.as_bytes());\n        }\n        let _ = child.wait();\n    }\n}"
}

> AGENT

Every mouse move triggers a re-render since state changes (hover_left_border, mouse_col, etc.). And the `detect_links` function in chat.rs checks `full_path.exists()` on every render for every potential path — that's filesystem I/O on every frame during mouse movement. That's the slowdown.

Let me fix both issues:

1. Remove the expensive `exists()` check from the render path — cache links instead
2. For Cmd+C/Cmd+V: add `REPORT_ALL_KEYS_AS_ESCAPE_CODES` flag and handle SUPER modifier

> AGENT

Done.

**Fixes:**
1. **Cmd+C** copies chat selection to clipboard via `pbcopy`. Ctrl+C also works as fallback. Neither leaks `c` into input — SUPER modifier is now filtered from char input.
2. **Cmd+V** pastes from clipboard via `pbpaste` into input.
3. **Performance** — removed `exists()` filesystem check from render path (was called every frame on mouse move). URL detection no longer allocates strings on every character position.

**Note:** Cmd+C/V requires a terminal that supports the kitty keyboard protocol (WezTerm, kitty, foot). Terminal.app and iTerm2 intercept Cmd+key before the app sees it. In those terminals, Ctrl+C copy still works when text is selected.

{

  "old_string": "fn paste_from_clipboard(state: &mut AppState) {\n    let output = match std::process::Command::new(\"pbpaste\").output() {\n        Ok(o) => o,\n        Err(_) => return,\n    };\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return;\n    }\n    if let Some(tab) = state.active_tab_mut() {\n        for ch in text.chars() {\n            if ch == '\\n' {\n                crate::ui::input::input_newline(&mut tab.input);\n            } else {\n                crate::ui::input::input_char(&mut tab.input, ch);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}",
  "new_string": "fn paste_from_clipboard(state: &mut AppState) {\n    let output = match std::process::Command::new(\"pbpaste\").output() {\n        Ok(o) => o,\n        Err(_) => return,\n    };\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return;\n    }\n    if let Some(tab) = state.active_tab_mut() {\n        let input = &mut tab.input;\n        let paste_lines: Vec<&str> = text.split('\\n').collect();\n        for (i, chunk) in paste_lines.iter().enumerate() {\n            // Insert chunk into current line at cursor\n            let chars: Vec<char> = input.lines[input.cursor_line].chars().collect();\n            let before: String = chars[..input.cursor_col].iter().collect();\n            let after: String = chars[input.cursor_col..].iter().collect();\n            input.lines[input.cursor_line] = format!(\"{}{}{}\", before, chunk, after);\n            input.cursor_col += chunk.chars().count();\n            // If not the last chunk, split into new line\n            if i < paste_lines.len() - 1 {\n                let current_line = input.lines[input.cursor_line].clone();\n                let chars: Vec<char> = current_line.chars().collect();\n                let left: String = chars[..input.cursor_col].iter().collect();\n                let right: String = chars[input.cursor_col..].iter().collect();\n                input.lines[input.cursor_line] = left;\n                input.cursor_line += 1;\n                input.lines.insert(input.cursor_line, right);\n                input.cursor_col = 0;\n            }\n        }\n        input.selection = None;\n        input.selection_anchor = None;\n    }\n}"
}

OK, the paste function I wrote doesn't call `input_newline` — it directly manipulates `input.lines`. So it shouldn't trigger submission. But wait — the user said "each line as separate message". That sounds like the terminal itself is sending each pasted line as a separate Enter keypress, not going through our paste function at all.

The issue is that **the terminal's bracketed paste mode isn't enabled**. Without it, pasting multi-line text sends each line as a separate Enter keypress. Need to enable bracketed paste:

  "new_string": "fn paste_from_clipboard(state: &mut AppState) {\n    let output = match std::process::Command::new(\"pbpaste\").output() {\n        Ok(o) => o,\n        Err(_) => return,\n    };\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);\n    paste_text(state, &text);\n}\n\nfn paste_text(state: &mut AppState, text: &str) {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return;\n    }\n    if let Some(tab) = state.active_tab_mut() {\n        let input = &mut tab.input;\n        let paste_lines: Vec<&str> = text.split('\\n').collect();\n        for (i, chunk) in paste_lines.iter().enumerate() {\n            let chars: Vec<char> = input.lines[input.cursor_line].chars().collect();\n            let before: String = chars[..input.cursor_col].iter().collect();\n            let after: String = chars[input.cursor_col..].iter().collect();\n            input.lines[input.cursor_line] = format!(\"{}{}{}\", before, chunk, after);\n            input.cursor_col += chunk.chars().count();\n            if i < paste_lines.len() - 1 {\n                let current_line = input.lines[input.cursor_line].clone();\n                let chars: Vec<char> = current_line.chars().collect();\n                let left: String = chars[..input.cursor_col].iter().collect();\n                let right: String = chars[input.cursor_col..].iter().collect();\n                input.lines[input.cursor_line] = left;\n                input.cursor_line += 1;\n                input.lines.insert(input.cursor_line, right);\n                input.cursor_col = 0;\n            }\n        }\n        input.selection = None;\n        input.selection_anchor = None;\n    }\n}"

383	fn in_selection(state: &InputState, li: usize, ci: usize) -> bool {
384	    let Some(sel) = &state.selection else { return false };
385	    let (sl, sc, el, ec) = if (sel.start_line, sel.start_col) < (sel.end_line, sel.end_col) {
386	        (sel.start_line, sel.start_col, sel.end_line, sel.end_col)
387	    } else {
388	        (sel.end_line, sel.end_col, sel.start_line, sel.start_col)
389	    };
390	    if li < sl || li > el { false }
391	    else if li == sl && li == el { ci >= sc && ci < ec }
392	    else if li == sl { ci >= sc }
393	    else if li == el { ci < ec }
394	    else { true }
395	}
396	
397	/// Advance one position in the text (col+1, or next line start).
398	fn advance_pos(lines: &[String], li: usize, ci: usize) -> (usize, usize) {
399	    let line_len = lines[li].chars().count();
400	    if ci < line_len { (li, ci + 1) }
401	    else if li + 1 < lines.len() { (li + 1, 0) }
402	    else { (li, ci) }
403	}
